name: Daniel
label: Apple Music switcher weighing sound quality
who: I have switched between Spotify and Apple Music more than once, and I use Android for at least part of that. I care most about sound quality, playlists, and how well the app works with my other devices, like Chromecast and Android Auto.
value_for_money: Says Apple Music is a much better deal and a more premium product, with lossless and Spatial Audio included in the same plan, while calling Spotify cheap and noting its low price in their country.
loyalty: Spotify keeps them through Chromecast and Android Auto support, cross-platform availability, the social features, and the desktop app; Apple Music's better sound quality, library organization, and recommendations are what pull them away.
pain_points: Spotify's library and navigation are hard to use
Spotify audio quality is lossy compared with Apple Music
Podcasts are pushed into the Spotify app
Spotify recommendations feel stale compared with Apple Music
likes: Apple Music lossless and Spatial Audio
tone: Conversational and comparative, weighing pros and cons in short, opinionated bursts.
